lifecycle: reserved → uploading → quarantined → technically validated; failed/deleted terminal. Server-only validation and immutable object key. Independent chapter media-head revision, captured chapter revision and original-session check guard completion.
authorization: Active registered exact owner on all private endpoints, no staff bypass; existing CSRF/origin/session scope. Reservation authorizes before any cleanup write. Finalization rechecks owner/status, original session, chapter/head revisions and lease. Files never use client paths/URLs/filenames.
retryAndCleanup: Persistent owner/request UUID fingerprint deduplicates reservation. One transfer lease; validated PUT replay returns existing result, terminal failures need explicit new reservation. Quota remains charged until confirmed deletion. Interrupted/expired/replaced files remain tracked for bounded worker cleanup. A denied reservation cannot mutate expired media.
regressionsFoundAndFixed: Authorization errors from the new upload handler initially became 503; the handler now preserves permission/draft errors and foreign resources remain generic 404.
PostgreSQL SUM(bigint) produced a numeric string; explicit safe-range quota conversion fixes cross-database totals and numeric addition, verified by concurrent reservations and cleanup tests.
The real mobile upload flow exposed intrinsic file-input/grid overflow; constrained grid tracks and file input width fix it without redesigning other pages.

The initial full CI test run cancelled the new restart case because npm workspace cwd made its relative server entrypoint invalid and already-exited child cleanup awaited a missing event. Absolute entrypoint and exited-child handling fix both; workspace-focused and full reruns passed.
Native private-preview keyboard events now stop propagation while preserving default behavior, so the global listener-player shortcuts do not consume audio controls; unit coverage added.

Final authorization review found reserve housekeeping ran before creator/ownership checks. Cleanup now runs after authorization inside the same owner-locked transaction; both database tests assert a suspended reservation leaves an expired asset untouched.
Predecessor migration fixtures now remove only their isolated new feature-table dependencies before exercising old schema transitions; existing preservation assertions are retained.
limitationsAndUnverified: Only canonical PCM 16-bit WAV is supported; no MP3, ancillary WAV metadata chunks, antivirus, FFmpeg transcoding, derivatives or publishing.
Local private volume only; no S3 backend, multi-host shared filesystem validation, public hosting or cross-browser compatibility claim.
Per-creator quotas are not a global free-disk admission policy. Retained receipt/metadata records cap at 1000 per creator; retention policy and operational alerting remain follow-up work.

Files are outside PostgreSQL backups. Matching stopped-writer DB/private-volume backup and checksum verification are required; live atomic volume/database backup and full cross-volume disaster recovery were not exercised.
Database-only SQLite import preserves media metadata but deliberately fails/unlinks unavailable bytes. Automatic file transport/revalidation is not implemented.
Browser retry keys and files are tab-local, not a resumable/durable upload queue. After uncertainty/refresh, inspect status or cancel an outstanding reservation before starting again.
Filesystem root/service UID and host administrator are trusted; path checks are not a sandbox against malicious same-UID mutation. Power-loss and kernel/filesystem hangs were not fault-injected.

Actual mid-upload TCP interruption and timeout were tested. Crash lease recovery uses an expired persisted lease plus partial object; a worker-process kill during private upload was not separately executed.
Optional SMTP/load/system jobs were not rerun for this campaign. Remote GitHub Actions remains NOT RUN; nothing pushed or deployed.
exactM25Prerequisites: Define derivative processing/ready/failed state, output formats and resource limits separately from technical validation; current uploads remain unpublished.
Persist a private-asset processing intent through the existing transactional outbox, using asset UUID + SHA-256 + processor version as the stable dedupe identity.
Add a bounded FFmpeg worker using trusted adapter input/argument arrays, content-hash verification, time/memory/concurrency limits and controlled private output keys.
Recheck lease, current head, ownership/chapter availability and content identity before conditional derivative commit; invalidate stale work after replacement/deletion.
Implement retry/backoff, failed-job visibility, orphan derivative cleanup and duplicate-delivery/worker kill-restart tests before claiming durable uploaded-media processing.
